name: Keeper of Vessels
description:
Once per rest, choose up to 3 vessels you are carrying. These become your active vessels, which can be used for your Summon ability. Any previously active vessels that you don't choose become inactive.

Also, at the end of each rest, each creature in one of your vessels (active or not) regains Endurance equal to its twice its BODY score, plus the Keeping of the vessel.

Describe how you carry your vessels.

improvements.name: The Very Best
improvements.description: You may choose up to 6 active vessels instead.
